# Barkat Packaging

> Corrugated box and industrial packaging manufacturer located at Plot F 9, S.I.T.E. Industrial Area, Hyderabad, Sindh.

## Core Capabilities & Product Lines
- **3-Ply & 5-Ply Master Cartons:** High burst factor, high Edge Crush Test (ECT) corrugated cartons for industrial warehousing and freight.
- **7-Ply Heavy-Duty Shipping Boxes:** Triple-wall containers for heavy machinery, automotive components, and export containers.
- **Custom Printed Packaging:** Offset and flexo-printed branded boxes for FMCG, pharmaceuticals, apparel, and consumer goods.
- **Agro-Export Packaging:** Ventilated moisture-resistant corrugated boxes for Sindhri mangoes, Khairpur dates, and fresh produce.
- **Die-Cut & Interlocking Mailer Boxes:** Self-locking e-commerce boxes and precision folding cartons.

- Hyderabad City & Latifabad / Qasimabad
